name: Rough log bridge
description: 4-5 raw debarked logs laid side by side across the gap: irregular length, diameter and ends, resting on bank rocks. No log is longer than 26 ft; a longer crossing (up to ~70 ft) gets log trestles (lashed splayed legs standing in the water or on the ground, feet below the bed, a cap log across) with every lane of logs laid end to end on the caps.
